name: No Committed Secrets or Signing Material
note: The strings these mutations write are not secrets; they are the shapes of secrets, and they are assembled by the runner rather than written here. A manifest holding one would itself be a credential-shaped string in a tracked file — the pre-commit hook blocked exactly that on the first attempt, which was the right answer. See SECRET_BAIT in run_mutation_audit.js.

mutations.name: a keystore password is written as a literal
mutations.why: The signing password in plain text is the one leak that cannot be undone by rotating a key — an attacker who has it can publish updates that Play accepts as genuine.
mutations.find: // Exported so sync/backup code cannot drift onto a different key string.
mutations.replace:
// {{BAIT:storePassword}}
// Exported so sync/backup code cannot drift onto a different key string.

mutations.name: a private key block appears in a tracked file
mutations.why: Once committed it is in the history forever, and the gate has to see it before the push rather than after.
mutations.find: // Exported so sync/backup code cannot drift onto a different key string.
mutations.replace:
// {{BAIT:privateKey}}
// Exported so sync/backup code cannot drift onto a different key string.
